name: code-doc-sync
description: Always-on doc hygiene for AI coding agents: check adjacent architecture docs before closing any behavior-changing task (scoped to observable-behavior/contract changes only), show concrete runtime types in flow diagrams rather than abstract declaration sites, run a cross-project rename/reshape as a deterministic checklist that keeps linked docs in sync, and check whether a runbook's manual follow-up step can be script-generated instead.

origin.note: Distilled from Rogers/Fido carrier integration work where two bug fixes were merged without updating flow trees or architecture docs, and where a flow tree showed an abstract declaration site instead of the concrete runtime type. See CarrierIntegrationServer commits 613daf50 and 2a7152ea.
origin.relationship: Principle 1 resynced 2026-09-01 from the sibling es-ai-toolkit pack, which had independently refined the same principle with a no-docs-folder carve-out and a purely-internal-change exemption. Principle 9 added 2026-09-01, mirrored same day from es-ai-toolkit's code-doc-sync pack (portable, not employer-specific). Principle 10 added 2026-09 from a runbook/script-artifact-generation pattern, mirrored identically into the sibling pack the same day. Versioned independently by design; this note tracks provenance for future drift checks — a 2026-09-08 baseline-gap-review pass also found the two repos' adapter-block condensation of principle 1 had drifted in wording despite identical baseline.md text, and reconciled the adapters to match.
